status.known_difference_vs_offline: early_call.Flight computes hb (table half-height at the ball's x) as a median over the whole labelled flight, i.e. including frames after the decision frame; online only past frames exist, so scores can differ slightly from the offline test scores (quantified by vs_offline once the frozen model is present)
status.fps_definitions: fps_sustained = frames / wall in 'max' mode; realtime = 120 fps arrivals; realtime@N = N fps arrivals (no backlog -> pure per-call processing latency); bounded = 120 fps arrivals, jump to newest frame when older than 100 ms
